csv_project_name: AE for Naval Surface Warfare Center
csv_scope_of_work: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. THERE WILL NOT BE A SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS, OR DRAWINGS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Panama City Division (NSWC PCD) is seeking eligible small businesses capable of performing Multi-Discipline Architect-Engineer (A-E) services for construction, repair, replacement, demolition, and alteration of facilities. A-E services may also be required for the improvement/upgrade of facilities and routine maintenance/repair projects. All work will occur at Naval Surface Warfare Center, Panama City Division (NSWC PCD).A-E services are required for planning, design, and construction in support of the renovations, repairs, replacement, demolition, alteration, and/or improvement of Government facilities for large and small design projects. A-E services may include multiple disciplines or single disciplines, including but not limited to architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, geotechnical, fire protection, and cost engineering control systems; lighting; and communications
